lane_impact: rebirth-elements + items-equipment: the link between the two element systems is ONE-WAY. Gear feeds combat (findBonusStat is added only in initAttackStats, StatsManager.as:1835) but is invisible to the 10/30/60 unlock gate. Refutes the survey's lane_impact assertion that affixes count toward the threshold; a rebuild that wires them in lets a player skip rebirths.
ledger_text: elements are TWO systems (rebirth skills **and** gear ATK/DEF typing) — the gear side is measured (A-17) but never linked to the rebirth domain.
text: Gear affixes on element ATK raise elemental damage but can never satisfy a skill unlock requirement — the requirement evaluator reads the base player stat only.

The ledger's Economy 'gold has legit non-cash faucets (rebirth/tournament/betting)' line is therefore about hard currency specifically, which is the whole point of that bullet — bind it to the right stat id or the faucet model is wrong by a factor of the coin/gold exchange.

ledger_text: **The stance tables (dmg 0.9/1.2/1.4, reach 300/200/100) are MASTERY-9 CEILING values, not base.** A level-1 Shugyosha does Light ×0.5 / Balanced ×1.0 / Heavy ×1.4 (Heavy is fixed); Heavy's *reach* also scales ×0.5→×0.9.
text: The v0.717 desktop client's per-stance slash multipliers are on disk and differ from the android build: Light x1.4, Balanced x(1 + 0.2*mastery*0.1), Heavy x(0.5 + 0.4*mastery*0.1) floored at 100, Reversed x1.4, Dual x1.0 — and the *0.1 scaling means mastery is a 0-10 domain, giving Heavy reach exactly 0.5 -> 0.9.

lane_impact: L2: do not wire SPD to meter fill in config — fill is a constant +1/frame regardless of stats, so empty->full is always 8.000 s. This also independently corroborates COMBAT_MEASUREMENTS f-5 ('fills PASSIVELY and LINEARLY with time … no event-driven jumps') against gap-F's 'charge begins on holding the slash input': the web code has no input term in the charge path at all. L5 should re-open gap-F on that basis.
text: SPD does NOT accelerate the Focus meter: getBaseReload() = 48 + SPD*6 is computed, passed into the player and stored, then never read anywhere in either bundle — the meter fills at a flat +1 per tick.

lane_impact: L2: the meter system has THREE reload-family numbers, not one — baseReload (48 + SPD*6, param 7), maxreload (192, hard-coded), and the 48-frame dead zone. Any config that collapses them will mis-simulate. The Android parameter names at MCSPlayer.as:182 are the Rosetta stone for the whole obfuscated web init signature and should be banked for every downstream lane.
ledger_text: ③ Focus numerics (max/fill/switch-cost).
text: Param 7 of the player init is baseReload = 48 + SPD*6 — a field distinct from maxreload, and the likely source of the survey's 120/192 confusion.
